> First find out which kind you have.

Send the request again with `Accept: */*`, which says you will take anything. If it succeeds, you have a genuine content negotiation problem and the fix is your Accept header or the server's supported formats. If it still fails, this is not negotiation: something is blocking the request, and on Apache-based hosting that is almost always mod_security, whose audit log will name the rule that fired.
